lines.beyond: south to Southside: through-running; second terminus and depot off-sheet

lines.name: Harbour Line
lines.beyond: north along Harbour Road past Crown Road; south with T1 down the Boulevard to Southside

lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

notes: Kept from tide's draft: T1 through the circus and a T2 Harbour Line on Harbour Road. Dropped: the two-way Sky Loop round the district. Its corners over the ring roads need R≥70, and the arc midpoint then sits 20.5 m inside the corner, over plots (S-C1). It also repeats S1's reach. The plan's concept is one S1 trunk (open question c1909f: retire the loops?). Sky should confirm.

Why T2 is needed: no stop on T1 (x=0) or S1 Harbour (340,0) reaches docks-east (262,-512) or harbour-east (262,-267) within transit.reach 250. T2 runs kerbside on the quay side of Harbour Road (x=306, tracks at 304.2/307.8, inside the 288–312 carriageway). It leaves the sheet at y 320.

Where T2 turns: south at Comet Row, R52 (vertex 306,-728), then west along Comet Row, sloping from z -728 to -710. It turns again with R52 (vertex 0,-710) into the Boulevard and shares T1's track to the sheet edge at y -780. That way no in-sheet terminus or loop is needed (T-L1). I checked both offset tracks (r±1.8) by hand against the street edges. The margins are about 1–2 m.

T1 loop is redrawn. On the old diagonal, near (-15,-32), the path left street space: it was 0.9 m outside the Boulevard and 7 m off the circus ring centreline (ring half-width 6). The new balloon stays in the Boulevard and on the ring, then in the island (≤30.1 m from centre). Radii are 25/26 (≥ radiusLoop 25). The ends at (±1.8,-56) meet the trunk's two tracks.

S1 loop is redrawn. On the old one, the fillets at (650,60) and (708,0) overlapped: tangent lengths 43.5 + 41.4 on an 83.4 m segment. The new balloon uses R40/45 (≥ radiusLoop 40). Every segment is long enough for its two tangents. It stays over the apron and water, x ≤ 755 of the 740 limit? No: the arc peak is x≈710, so it stays inside the sheet. The trunk and stations are unchanged.

Interchange distances (I don't place interchanges): T2 to S1 Harbour (340,0) is 34 m. T1 Crown Circus stop (0,-72) to S1 Crown Circus (95,0) is about 119 m. T2 to T1 is shared track on the Boulevard south of Comet Row. All are ≤150.

Open, not resolved here: plan question c1909f, whether T1 terminates on the circus loop or runs up Crown Avenue. I kept the loop. I have not run the plan checker; the geometry above was checked by hand only.

handoffs.ask: Place T2 stops on path 'harbour', 300–500 m apart, including one at z≈0 as the interchange with S1 Harbour (340,0), and an interchange with T1 at Comet Row on the shared Boulevard section. Without these, T2 fails N-C1. Re-check that T1's circus stop (0,-72) still fits on the trunk with the redrawn loop.
T2 shares T1's track on the Boulevard from Comet Row south to the sheet edge (y -780) and on to Southside. Timetable both lines on that shared section.
